issues.description: replace_with_none identifies the frame-condition exception with the replacement PTE's post-state address instead of the removed PTE's entry-state address.
issues.rationale: The function assigns self.pte = new_child.into_pte() at line 263 before establishing spt_do_not_change_except. The contract and assumed proof fact at lines 246 and 299 therefore read the replacement PTE address. new_absent does not require that address to equal old(self).pte.pte_paddr(), so the contract may exempt an unrelated slot while constraining the actually removed slot as unchanged. Repair 3c55e81c changes both sites to old(self).pte.pte_paddr().
